 Together for Science and Health: Global launch events
 Together for Science and Health: Global launch events
 10 November 2026 13:30 – 17:30 UTC Time 
 Online, 
 Reading time: 
 Live stream
 The events below, listed in chronological order, will take place on Tuesday, 10 November. 
 All times are in CET (Geneva time), with corresponding times in other time zones provided where relevant. Most events will be livestreamed unless otherwise indicated. 
 Join us by registering for an event or watching the available livestreams!
 Consortium of Universities for Global Health webinar on the launch of Together for Science and Health - Asia focus
 Time : 2:30-3:30 AM CET
 Corresponding times: New Delhi 7:00 AM | Bangkok and Jakarta 8:30 AM | Singapore, Manila and Beijing 9:30 AM | Tokyo and Seoul 10:30 AM | Sydney 12:30 PM | Auckland 2:30 PM
 Organizer : Consortium of Universities for Global Health
 Short description : CUGH is hosting a one-hour regional webinar to bring together science and health leaders from Asia on the occasion of the launch of Together for Science and Health. The webinar will reinforce the central importance of communication in building trust in science, and showcase promising efforts that ensure scientific progress is understood, reaches the right people, and inspires change.
 Flyer Registration South-East Asia regional science dialogue webinar: Together for Science and Health
 Time : 9:00-10:20 AM CET | 1:30-2:50 PM IST
 Organizer : WHO South-East Asia Regional Office
 Short description : Through compelling examples of scientific discoveries that have transformed public health, the dialogue will demonstrate the value of evidence and research, showcase how evidence informs WHO recommendations and national policies, and explore emerging opportunities to strengthen evidence generation and its translation into health impact.
 Flyer Youth Futures Lab: Imagine 2035, together
 Time : 9:30 AM-12:00 PM CET
 Location : Learning Planet Institute, Paris, and online
 Organizers : WHO, Learning Planet, the UNESCO Chair Global Health and Education, the WHO Youth Council and the WHO Fides network.
 Short description : The Youth Futures Lab brings together 40 young people aged 18 to 30, from health and non-health backgrounds, for a two-and-a-half-hour foresight workshop. Working in groups coached by experts and members of WHO's Fides network, participants will imagine a world in 2035 in which trust in health information and in science has been restored. Each group will design the cover of a magazine published that year, then defend it in a one-minute pitch before a jury.
 Please note that applications to participate in this event have closed. 
 Please note that the livestream will be available only from 11:00 AM CET onwards. 
 Flyer Launch of the OECD-WHO Tool for the Anticipatory Governance of Emerging Technologies in Health
 Time : 10:00-11:30 AM CET
 Location : OECD Headquarters, Paris and online
 Organizers : OECD, WHO
 Short description : The WHO and the OECD have partnered to develop TArGET Health, a tool designed to strengthen stakeholders' capacity to respond to emerging assessment needs, evaluate technologies as potential solutions to health challenges, support strategic decision-making, and inform policy and technology governance processes.
 Flyer Registration Launch of WHO Global movement Together for Health and Science in Chile
 Time : 12:45-2 PM CET | 8:45-10 AM CLST
 Location :  Salón de Honor, Pontificia Universidad Católica, Santiago, Chile
 Organizers : Chilean Collaborating Centres (Chilean League against Epilepsy ; Escuela de Salud Publica, Universidad de Chile ; Escuela de Obstetricia, Departamento de Promoción de la Salud de la Mujer y el Recién Nacido; Centre for Global Intercultural Health, I Facultad de Medicina Clínica Alemana, Universidad del Desarrollo; Department of Occupational Health , Institute of Public Health ; División de Planificación y Desarrollo Estratégico, Fondo Nacional de Salud ; Centro Interdisciplinario para el Desarrollo del Adulto Mayor – Gerópolis, Universidad de Valparaiso.
 Sponsorship : Facultad de Medicina Universidad Católica de Chile 
 Short description: The objective is to highlight the role of science in serving people and strengthening trust in scientific knowledge. The discussion will draw on experiences across health, public policy, refractory epilepsy, the workplace, and other areas of society.
 Please note that this event may not be livestreamed. 
 Flyer Registration Strengthening evidence-informed and participatory policy-making for better health
 Time : 1:30-5:30 PM CET
 Location : Campus Biotech and online (only the high-level segment from 1:30-2:30 PM and the plenary reporting back and closing from 4:45-5:15 PM will be available for online participation and livestream)
 Organizers : Geneva Health Forum, Geneva Digital Health Hub, WHO
 Short description : Organized as part of the Geneva Health Forum, this event will bring together policy-makers, scientists, health professionals, civil society and international organizations to explore how scientific evidence and citizen participation can strengthen health policy and decision-making. Through a high-level panel, interactive workshops and an immersive anticipatory lab, participants will exchange experiences and identify practical approaches to bridging science, policy and society, fostering more inclusive, evidence-informed policies for better health outcomes.
 Registration : Geneva Launch (in-person registration) | Geneva Launch (online registration) 
 Flyers: Programme |  Immersive Anticipatory Lab | Agenda 
 Child Health in the Age of Digital Information
 Time : 2:15-3:15 PM CET
 Location : Paris Peace Forum, Paris
 Organizers : Paris Peace Forum, WHO
 Short description: Held as part of the Child Summit at the Paris Peace Forum, this high-level session examines how digital environments shape the way children, adolescents and their parents access, understand and use health information. Ministers, scientists, media and digital actors will address three priorities: ensuring that children and their families have access to reliable health information, mobilizing research and evidence to inform public policy, and strengthening the accountability of platforms and digital actors.
 This event will not be livestreamed. The recordings will be made available shortly after. 
 Flyer Programme Africa regional webinar:  A dialogue on Together for Science and Health
 Time : 15:30–17:00 CET | 15:30–17:00 WAT
 Organizer : WHO Regional Office for Africa, in collaboration with WHO Headquarters
 Short description A regional dialogue to introduce the Together for Science & Health movement to regional stakeholders and identify opportunities to strengthen the contribution of African research to health policy and practice. Approaches to translating scientific evidence into health policies and programmes and strengthening public engagement and trust in science will be explored.
 Registration/participation: https://who.zoom.us/j/99968269978 (Meeting ID: 999 6826 9978 Passcode: dG7x#MNa)
 Flyer Consortium of Universities for Global Health webinar on the launch of Together for Science and Health - Africa and Middle East focus
 Time : 4:00-5:00 PM CET
 Corresponding times: Accra andamp; Dakar 3:00 PM | Lagos 4:00 PM | Johannesburg and Cairo 5:00 PM | Nairobi | Riyadh and Doha 6:00 PM | Dubai 7:00 PM
 Organizer : Consortium of Universities for Global Health
 Short description : CUGH is hosting a one-hour regional webinar to bring together science and health leaders from Africa and the Middle East on the occasion of the launch of Together for Science and Health. The webinar will reinforce the central importance of communication in building trust in science, and showcase promising efforts that ensure scientific progress is understood, reaches the right people, and inspires change.
 Flyer Registration Scaling Innovation for Global Health: Bridging Science, Technology, Policy and Access
 Time : 5:30–7:30 AM CET / 10:00 AM–12:00 PM IST
 Organizer : Kalam Institute of Health Technology (KIHT), WHO Collaborating Centre for Health Innovation
 Format : Kalam Convention Centre, AMTZ, Andhra Pradesh, India, and online
 Short description : This event will bring together researchers, innovators, health professionals, industry partners and policymakers to explore how science and health innovation can be translated into accessible and scalable solutions. The discussion will focus on strengthening connections across science, technology, policy and access to support evidence-informed innovation and advance better health for all.
 Flyer Strengthening Trust in Public Health Worldwide
 Time : 6:00-7:00 PM CET | 12:00-1:00 PM EST
 Location : Winslow Auditorium, Yale University
 Organizers : Yale School of Public Health, Jackson School of Global Affairs
 Short description: A panel bringing together Yale faculty and students to discuss Together for Science and Health, the broader landscape of trust in public health, and ongoing work to better understand its drivers, consequences, and potential responses.
 Flyer Quality Communication for Science and Health: Building Trust in the Digital Era
 Time : 6:00-7:00 PM CET | 12:00-1:00 PM ET
 Event type : Webinar
 Organizers : CUNY Graduate School of Public Health and Health Policy, its Health Communication for Social Change program, and the Journal of Health Communication: International Perspectives
 Short description : An online session exploring how to communicate quality health information effectively, including what people around the world want to know, whom they trust, and the opportunities and challenges of communicating science in the digital era.
 Please note that this event will not be livestreamed. 
 Flyer Registration Pre-launch event: PAHO for Science and Health: Clinical trial accelerator milestones
 Day : Friday 6 November
 Time : 5:00-5:00 PM CET | 10:00-11:00 AM EST
 Organizer : Pan American Health Organization
 Short description : This virtual seminar will highlight PAHO's work over the past three years to improve the efficiency and impact of clinical trials. It will also feature the launch of PAHO's Regulation for Research in the Americas (REGIA) platform. English - Spanish translation will be available.
 Please note that this event will not be livestreamed.
